name: Kyouka Jikken 3 ~Kurutta Bourei no Acme Idenshi Nyotai Kaizou Saishuu Shou~
original_name: 狂化実験３～狂った亡霊のアクメ遺伝子女体改造・最終章～
source:
The research facility sat before him. Here. Finally. 
His mind shook with uncertain dread. After decades, the mystery he'd been solving was so close, but as he stood in front of the concrete structure, the taste in his mouth was something else. 
In his hand, he held a letter. It described secret details of this facility where his father had come. It was addressed to his mother, who died when he was born. 
The past... the letter... this strange place... 
It would all come to a wild conclusion. 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE069873.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
研究设施就在眼前。这里。终于到了。
不确定的恐惧令他的内心动摇。数十年来，他一直试图破解那个谜团，如今答案已经近在咫尺；可站在混凝土建筑前时，嘴里泛起的却是另一种滋味。
他手中握着一封信。信里写下了这座设施的机密细节，他的父亲曾经来到这里。收信人是他的母亲，而母亲在生下他时便已去世。
过去……信件……这个诡异的地方……
一切都将在疯狂中迎来终局。

[引自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE069873.html]DLsite English[/url]]
